1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Pradaxa Pellet Packs  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is 8 years of age or younger  
 
OR 
 
2 - ALL of the following:  


--- PDF page 1339 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1339 
 
 2.1 Patient is between 9 and 12 years of age  
 
AND 
 
 2.2 Requested medication is being used for ONE of the following diagnoses:  
• 
Treatment of venous thromboembolic events (VTE) in patients who have been treated 
with a parenteral anticoagulant for at least 5 days  
• 
To reduce the risk of recurrence of VTE in patients who have been previously treated  
 
AND 
 
 2.3 ONE of the following:  
• 
Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to generic dabigatran capsules 
(verified via paid pharmacy claims or submitted chart notes)  
• 
Patient is unable to swallow oral tablets/capsules  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
9/4/2026  
Replaced Brand Pradaxa capsules with generic dabigatran capsules 
in the embedded step criterion.
